biotools.summary: The South American Archaeological Isotopic Database (SAAID) is a comprehensive open-access resource aggregating stable and radiogenic isotope measurements from human individuals, animals, and plants across South America. It contains 53,781 measurements and valuable contextual information facilitating spatiotemporal meta-analyses.
